note: Sound effects for the fable, made with ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 through the full ElevenLabs connector. What is generated follows decision 17 in docs/reviews/2026-10-fable.md: curtain cloth on wooden rings, one 8-10 s rustle, a small wet touch and water lapping, 2-4 takes each, chosen by ear. Night air and the ripples' decay are made in code. No crickets, no paw steps.

terms.source: https://elevenlabs.io/sound-effects-terms (ElevenCreative Terms, Exhibit 4, last updated 9 October 2026)
terms.film: Permitted: Exhibit 4, section 2 names incorporating Output into films and other productions, and publicly performing it. Unlike the Music Terms, there is no film exclusion.
terms.conditions: Commercial use only where the plan permits it; Output used only combined with other material; never offered on a standalone basis, as isolated audio files or samples, or in a sound or effects library. Community Sharing stays off.
terms.consequence: The takes stay local in audition/fable/sfx/ (gitignored) and reach visitors only mixed into the film's soundtrack.

s1.purpose: The four generated effects of decision 17, placed on radio cut v1.
s1.rate: 11 credits per second of audio, per take (from the estimates)

curtains.label: curtains (cloth on wooden rings)
curtains.prompt: Heavy cotton curtain drawn slowly open by hand, wooden rings sliding along a wooden pole, soft cloth swish, close-mic in a small quiet room
curtains.place: the 6 s lead-in before the first line (0-6 s); the curtains only open

branch.label: the branch (one leaf-and-wood rustle)
branch.prompt: Leafy green branch slowly pulled down and bent low, one continuous soft rustle of leaves with faint creaks of springy wood, close-mic, still night, quiet background
branch.place: from 'The fox pulled a branch over the water.' (113.4 s), one rustle carried unbroken across the cut from his side to hers (decision 8)

touch.label: the touch (small wet touch)
touch.prompt: A small paw dipping once into still pond water, soft wet touch with a tiny splash, close-mic, quiet
touch.place: the 1.0 s gap inside paragraph 23 (131.85-132.85 s), the film's only hard sync (decision 9); the ripples' decay follows in code. Never glass, never an impact.

pond.label: the pond (water lapping, loop)
pond.prompt: Very gentle water lapping against a muddy pond bank, slow soft small laps, calm still night, close-mic
pond.place: a quiet bed under the pond scenes, from the meeting at the pond on; its in and out and level are set in the mix, under the night air's role

recommended.why: Four takes of the three short, placed sounds (the touch is the hard sync and costs 22 a take); two of the 20 s loop, which is most of the cost and the least exposed.

s1.status: priced 2026-11-08 (estimate_only, nothing generated); waiting for the artist
